description: NT-12 rule (a): known records whose places are all on decks the release tier does not run yet, each with the item that brings its deck into the corpus. check:native-coverage fails for a record without such a place that is not listed here, and for a listed record that no longer needs to be (NT-10 moves the round decks into the corpus and empties this list). Ids per application file of scripts/native-acceptance/known/.
